Class BorrowingService

java.lang.Object
com.library.service.BorrowingService
public class BorrowingService extends Object
Handles borrowing operations for users.

This service enforces borrowing rules such as:

  • Users cannot borrow if they have unpaid fines
  • Users cannot borrow if they have overdue loans
The actual creation of loans is delegated to LoanService.

Supports borrowing both books and CDs.

  • Method Details

    • borrowBook

      public Loan borrowBook(String userId, String bookId)
      Allows a user to borrow a book.

      Borrowing is blocked if:

      • The user has unpaid fines
      • The user has overdue loans
      If all checks pass, the request is forwarded to LoanService.borrowBook(String, String).
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the borrowing user
      bookId - the ID of the book being borrowed
      Returns:
      a newly created Loan
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the user is not allowed to borrow

    • borrowCd

      public Loan borrowCd(String userId, String cdId)
      Allows a user to borrow a CD.

      Same borrowing rules apply as with books:

      • No unpaid fines
      • No overdue loans
      Uses LoanService.borrowCd(String, String) internally.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the borrowing user
      cdId - the ID of the CD to borrow
      Returns:
      a newly created Loan
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the user cannot borrow due to fines or overdue loans
